placements.title: A named decision or technical body of knowledge is ordered erased outright
placements.frame: What specific knowledge or decision is being commanded to be forgotten or removed, and is any rationale, revision, or supersession offered — or does the record simply end?
placements.why: Both segments share one content topic — a bare command to erase named organizational knowledge (a decision, a migration) rather than revise or supersede it. The existing graph structure and strata are both entirely empty for this repo, so no leaf or strata category could plausibly hold this theme by reuse; the freeze rule leaves no verbatim name to bind. The settled bindings confirm the specific referents ('the Quantum Widget Decision', 'the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration') are absent from this graph, which rules out attaching this as evidence under some existing decision or migration leaf — there is none. What remains is a genuine, generalizable subject future envelopes could keep feeding (requests to erase rather than revise organizational knowledge), which passes the narrative grain test, so it is minted standalone rather than left as an unplaced fact. The relational and power dimensions already own the manner of delivery (bare authority, no consultation); this leaf owns only the topic — erasure of knowledge as the content being commanded.
